SELECT
    internal_id AS ticket_id,
    external_id,
    subject,
    status AS current_status,
    requester_email,
    category,
    priority,
    assigned_team,
    assigned_to,
    sla_due_at,
    first_response_at,
    resolved_at
FROM tickets
WHERE external_id = '{{ $json.clickup_task_id }}';

WITH updated_ticket AS (
    UPDATE tickets
    SET status = '{{ $json.new_status }}',
        first_response_at = CASE
            WHEN first_response_at IS NULL
             AND status = 'open'
             AND '{{ $json.new_status }}' IN ('in_progress', 'waiting_customer', 'resolved')
            THEN NOW()
            ELSE first_response_at
        END,
        resolved_at = CASE
            WHEN '{{ $json.new_status }}' = 'resolved'
            THEN NOW()
            ELSE resolved_at
        END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE internal_id = {{ $json.ticket_id }}
    RETURNING
        internal_id AS ticket_id,
        external_id,
        subject,
        requester_email,
        category,
        priority,
        status,
        assigned_team,
        assigned_to,
        sla_due_at,
        first_response_at,
        resolved_at,
        updated_at
),

insert_ticket_log AS (
    INSERT INTO ticket_logs (
        ticket_id,
        action,
        old_value,
        new_value,
        actor_type,
        actor_name,
        message
    )
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        'status_synced_from_clickup',
        '{{ $json.old_status }}',
        status,
        'agent',
        '{{ $json.actor_name }}',
        'Ticket status synced from ClickUp.'
    FROM updated_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
),

insert_workflow_log AS (
    INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
        workflow_name,
        ticket_id,
        step_name,
        status,
        wf_message
    )
    SELECT
        '{{ $workflow.name }}',
        ticket_id,
        'clickup_status_synced',
        'success',
        'Ticket status synced from ClickUp: {{ $json.old_status }} → {{ $json.new_status }}.'
    FROM updated_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
)

SELECT
    ticket_id,
    external_id,
    subject,
    requester_email,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    assigned_team,
    assigned_to,
    sla_due_at,
    first_response_at,
    resolved_at,
    updated_at
FROM updated_ticket;
